data.name: Mosin-Nagant

weaponImprint.name: Samosek
weaponImprint.trait: Attacks ignore 1 point of stability index. When possessing [effect:4b5fd3bb-8d4a-44e7-ba99-b48331d2e194], attacks additionally ignore another 1 point of stability index.
weaponImprint.effect: Phase damage is increased by 10%/12%/14%/16%/18%/20%. Electric damage is increased by another 10%/12%/14%/16%/18%/20%.
weaponImprint.imprintDescription: Increase damage dealt to PMCs by 2.5%. If the target has [effect:8cfe89a9-404a-42e5-9cc7-5bf57b070887|doll:mosin-nagant], increase it by an additional 2.5%.

data.effects: A Doll who loves to help others and strives to improve her negative mindset. Her motto is to never avoid challenges; once motivated, she gives her all. While negative thoughts may linger in her neural cloud, her radiant smile and enthusiastic actions surely inspire many of her companions.

level1.description: Selects an enemy target within 9 tiles and deals Physical damage equal to 80% of attack to it.

When an allied unit attacks an enemy unit outside of turn but within range, if that enemy unit is in Stability Break, Mosin-Nagant performs 1 instance of [effect:ab2e634f-d257-44e3-af90-ce66a6ac43f3], dealing Physical damage equal to 80% of her attack and 2 points of stability damage. This effect can trigger up to 2 times per turn. After a Support Attack, gains 2 points of Confectance Index and also gains [effect:4b5fd3bb-8d4a-44e7-ba99-b48331d2e194] for 2 turns.

level2.description: When an allied unit attacks an enemy unit outside of turn but within range, if that enemy unit is in Stability Break, Mosin-Nagant performs 1 instance of [effect:ab2e634f-d257-44e3-af90-ce66a6ac43f3], dealing Physical damage equal to 80% of her attack and 2 points of stability damage. This effect can trigger up to 2 times per turn. After a Support Attack, gains 2 points of Confectance Index and also gains [effect:4b5fd3bb-8d4a-44e7-ba99-b48331d2e194] for 2 turns. Before the Support Attack, gains 1 stack of [effect:92c897fb-6469-4746-9cdf-ff28c46af53b|doll:mosin-nagant].

vertebraeUpgrade.effect: Before performing a Support Attack, gains 1 stack of [effect:92c897fb-6469-4746-9cdf-ff28c46af53b|doll:mosin-nagant].

level3.description: When an allied unit attacks an enemy unit outside of turn but within range, if that enemy unit is in Stability Break, Mosin-Nagant performs 1 instance of [effect:ab2e634f-d257-44e3-af90-ce66a6ac43f3], dealing Physical damage equal to 80% of her attack and 2 points of stability damage. When an Electric debuff is applied to an enemy target outside of turn, it triggers [effect:bf9cca5c-a432-44ad-ba77-05ba7435b1dd]. Support Attack can trigger up to 3 times per turn. After a Support Attack, gains 2 points of Confectance Index and also gains [effect:4b5fd3bb-8d4a-44e7-ba99-b48331d2e194] for 2 turns. Before the Support Attack, gains 1 stack of [effect:92c897fb-6469-4746-9cdf-ff28c46af53b|doll:mosin-nagant].

vertebraeUpgrade.effect: When an Electric debuff is applied to an enemy target outside of turn, gains [effect:bf9cca5c-a432-44ad-ba77-05ba7435b1dd]. The maximum number of Support Attack increases by 1.

imagoforms.effect: Damage dealt by Support Attacks is increased by 5%.
Physical and phase damage taken is reduced by 5%.
Electric damage dealt is increased by 5%.
Damage dealt to enemy targets in Stability Break is increased by 10%.
Damage dealt against enemy units that are more than 5 tiles away is increased by 12%.

effectDetails.mainDetails: Attacks deal Electric damage, increasing damage by 30%, effective once. This buff cannot be cleansed.

upgrades.upgradeDetails: Attacks deal Electric damage, increasing damage by 40%. Triggers 1 time. This buff cannot be cleansed.

dollEffects.effectDetails: Electric damage taken from Mosin-Nagant is increased by 15%. This is considered a [effect:8cfe89a9-404a-42e5-9cc7-5bf57b070887] effect. Considered an Electric debuff.
Applies [effect:8cfe89a9-404a-42e5-9cc7-5bf57b070887] to the target for 1 turn before attacking. Activates 1 time. This is considered an Electric buff.
Increase the critical rate and critical damage of ultimate skills by 5%. Maximum of 4 stacks. This buff cannot be cleansed.
Performs a Support Attack; cannot be triggered by another Support Attack.
Increases the range of Ultimate Skills by 1 tile. Considered a buff.
Damage taken is converted to [effect:8cfe89a9-404a-42e5-9cc7-5bf57b070887]. Considered an Electric debuff.
